items.name: Medical-Emergency-room-according-to-priority-and-referral-code
items.description: The management of a medical centre wishes you to develop a program that will manage Its emergency room patients and calculate and output a patients bill. Input to this program consists of the patients Id, the patient's name and his/her priority level. A referral code (refer to the table below) is assigned based on the priority level which Is then used to determine the charges to be applied. Assume valid Input.  Note the following: • If the priority level is 1, the patient is automatically referred to the Doctor on Duty (code D). • If the priority level Is 2, then the head nurse will input one of the listed codes (other than code D) to refer the patient. • The patient's bill for visiting the emergency room Includes a standard fee of $1500 (use a constant) along with the relevant cost for the referral. • The output should consist of the patients Id, name, referral explanation and bill amount.  The following criteria apply: D:patient referred to doctor on duty N:Patient refeered to nurses H:patient referred to health care R: Patient referred to Regional hospital
